product.title: At-Home Private Wine or NA Wine Tasting Experience in Austin

description.text: Host a private wine tasting with a certified sommelier at your Austin home or lodging. Walk through three guided tastings for your group of up to 15 while learning how to evaluate aroma, structure, and finish without fighting crowded tasting rooms. Stops include Private Austin Location, Guided Wine Tasting Flight, Sommelier Q&A. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Austin skyline views, lake corridors, and Hill Country highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Austin who want a guided Capital City experience without coordinating meeting points, trailheads, or photo locations on their own.
